about: SYNTHETIC memories for dredd/recall-bench.mjs: invented for the benchmark, about an invented product, so the numbers are reproducible and no real memory enters the repo. Never copy a real memory in here.

memories.title: No deploys after Thursday noon
memories.body: Releases stop at 12:00 on Thursday and resume on Monday morning; a weekend page costs more than the delay. A hotfix in the window goes through the on-call lead, who writes down why it could not wait.

memories.title: Invoice PDFs embed their fonts
memories.body: Customers on locked-down printers saw boxes where the letters should be, because the generator referenced system fonts. The renderer now embeds the subset of every font it uses.

memories.title: Webhook retries back off to six hours, then stop
memories.body: A failed delivery is retried at 1, 5 and 30 minutes, then hourly up to six hours; after that the event is marked undeliverable and the receiving account gets an email naming the endpoint.

memories.title: Timestamps are stored in UTC and rendered in the viewer's zone
memories.body: Every column holding an instant is timestamptz written in UTC. Conversion happens only at display, using the zone the viewer's browser reports, never the server's.

memories.title: Uploads over 25 MB are refused before storage
memories.body: The upload endpoint reads Content-Length and rejects anything above 25 MB with a message naming the limit, so a giant file never lands in the bucket half-written.

memories.title: The search index rebuilds at 02:00
memories.body: A full rebuild runs nightly at two in the morning server time; edits made during the day are indexed incrementally within a minute, so the nightly job is a repair, not the main path.

memories.title: Password reset links expire after 30 minutes
memories.body: A reset link is single-use and dies 30 minutes after it is sent. Asking for a second link kills the first.

memories.title: CSV exports start with a byte-order mark
memories.body: Without the BOM, spreadsheet apps on Windows opened exports as Latin-1 and mangled accented names. Every CSV now begins with the UTF-8 BOM.

memories.title: New feature flags default to off in production
memories.body: A flag ships disabled in production and enabled in staging; turning it on for customers is a separate, recorded change with a named owner.

memories.title: Public API: 600 requests per minute per key
memories.body: The limit is per API key, not per account, with a burst of 100. A throttled call gets 429 and a Retry-After header in seconds.

memories.title: Hard bounces go on the suppression list for good
memories.body: An address that hard-bounces once is never mailed again unless its owner re-confirms it from inside the product. Soft bounces get three tries.

memories.title: Dark theme text needs 4.5:1 contrast
memories.body: Grey-on-charcoal labels failed the accessibility audit. Body text holds 4.5:1 against its background in both themes; large headings may drop to 3:1.

memories.title: Applied migrations are never edited
memories.body: Once a schema migration has run anywhere it is history. A correction is a new migration with its own number, even for a typo.

memories.title: Static assets carry a content hash in their filename
memories.body: Scripts and stylesheets are named by the hash of their bytes so they can be cached for a year; only index.html is served with no-cache.

memories.title: The dead-letter queue is reviewed every Monday
memories.body: Messages that failed every retry sit in the dead-letter queue. On Mondays the on-call engineer replays or discards each one and notes which consumer threw.

memories.title: Tap targets are at least 44 points
memories.body: Icon buttons on phones were missed by thumbs. Anything tappable gets a 44-point hit area even when the drawn icon is smaller.

memories.title: Onboarding is three screens, never more
memories.body: Every extra signup screen lost about a tenth of new users in the funnel test. Anything past three moves into the product, asked when it is first needed.

memories.title: Audit logs are kept forever
memories.body: Security and billing audit rows are never pruned; they move to cold storage after a year but stay queryable.

memories.title: Money is stored as integer cents
memories.body: Amounts are integers in the currency's minor unit with the ISO code beside them. Floating point rounding once put a cent of drift on every hundredth invoice.

memories.title: A backup restore drill runs every quarter
memories.body: Backups that were never restored are hopes. Each quarter a recent snapshot is restored into a scratch environment and the row counts are compared.

memories.title: Analytics loads only after consent
memories.body: The tracking script is injected only once the visitor accepts the cookie banner; declining leaves no third-party request on the page.

memories.title: Company SSO claims accounts by email domain
memories.body: When a company verifies its domain and turns on single sign-on, existing accounts on that domain are moved under it at their next sign-in, with an email first.

memories.title: List endpoints page by cursor, not offset
memories.body: Offset paging skipped and repeated rows when records were inserted mid-scroll. Lists return an opaque next cursor instead.

memories.title: A flaky test is fixed the same day, never skipped
memories.body: An intermittent failure is a bug in the test or the code. Marking it skipped hid a real race for a month, so it is fixed or reverted that day.

memories.title: Summaries use the small model
memories.body: Conversation summaries run on the small, cheap model; the large model is reserved for drafting replies, where the quality difference was measurable.

memories.title: Shipping labels print at 203 dpi
memories.body: Thermal printers in the warehouse are 203 dpi; rendering labels at 300 made barcodes unscannable after scaling.

memories.title: First support reply within four business hours
memories.body: A ticket gets a human answer inside four business hours; an automatic acknowledgement does not count.

memories.title: Annual plans are two months free
memories.body: Yearly billing costs ten times the monthly price. No other discount stacks on top of it.

memories.title: Error messages say what to do next
memories.body: A message that only says something went wrong is not finished; it names the action the person can take, or who to contact.

memories.title: Dependencies are pinned through the lockfile
memories.body: Version ranges let a minor release of a parser change behaviour under us. Production installs from the lockfile only.

memories.title: The dashboard is client-rendered only
memories.body: Server rendering the signed-in dashboard doubled its cost for no visible gain; the marketing pages are the only server-rendered surface.

memories.title: Geocoding results are cached for 30 days
memories.body: Address-to-coordinate lookups are paid per call, so each result is cached for thirty days keyed by the normalised address.

memories.title: No push notifications between 21:00 and 08:00
memories.body: Pushes queued overnight are held and delivered at eight in the recipient's local time. Security alerts are the only exception.

memories.title: Log lines redact anything shaped like a credential
memories.body: The logger masks bearer values, API keys and session cookies before writing, after one leaked into a shared dashboard.

memories.title: SMS falls back to the second carrier after two failures
memories.body: Two failed sends to one number through the primary carrier switch that number to the backup carrier for a day.

memories.title: Every product image needs alt text written by a person
memories.body: Generated descriptions read as noise to screen-reader users; the upload form asks for one plain sentence.

memories.title: Each worker opens at most 10 database connections
memories.body: The database ran out of connection slots at peak. Every worker process caps its pool at 10, and a long query is a bug, not a reason for more.

memories.title: Trials last 14 days, no card required
memories.body: The free trial is two weeks and asks for no payment details; on day 12 the account gets one reminder.

memories.title: Trials last 30 days
memories.body: The original trial was a month long. Conversion was the same at two weeks, so it was shortened.

memories.title: Meeting invites attach an .ics file
memories.body: Calendar apps that ignore the inline invite still import the attached .ics, so every scheduled meeting email carries one.
